about_the_game:
DodgeKill is not your typical game. Here, there's no character to control—your cursor is the one taking all the action!

Minimalist yet dynamic

A game visually simple, some geometric shapes, a few colors, and that's all.
But if we combine all this, we get a game with varied enemies and complex challenges!

Easy to learn, hard to master

Is it playable with only the mouse ? Absolutely! 
You just need to move the cursor. But make no mistake, even if the controls are simple, the game remains no less complicated! 
(Controllers and touchscreens are also compatible 🙂)

Gameplay

  • A unique gameplay playable entirely with the mouse

  • Various level filled with surprises, for increasingly difficult challenges

  • A tough difficulty that tests your nerves and will give you great satisfaction with each victory

  • Simple and intuitive controls, accessible to all players

  • Challenges available to increase the difficulty even more

 

Ready to take on the challenge ?

short_description: DodgeKill is a minimalist bullet hell arcade game. Your cursor is both your heart and your weapon : dodge enemy waves, then strike back! Will you survive until the end ?
